messages:
maria: Hey folks — quick sync on postmortem follow-ups from last regional failover. Goal: confirm owners + realistic timelines for remediation, and pick a date for a short game-day rehearsal. Proposed agenda: 1) multi-region routing policy fixes, 2) backup verification + retention audit, 3) restore runbook dry-run, 4) recurring incident pattern analysis.

jamal: +1. I can drive routing policy changes. Need an infra review first.

alex: I can do backup verification and retention audit. Will need access to the KMS logs.

priya: Happy to run the restore runbook dry-run. Suggest we make the dry-run non-disruptive (use staging snapshots). :thumbsup:

riley: I can take the recurring pattern analysis. I have a small query that looks for spike-correlation between routing changes and cache-evictions.

maria: Great. Can we put concrete owners + target dates here so the postmortem action tracker is actionable? I'll draft a quick table.

jamal: Routing policy changes (owner: jamal) — target: 2 weeks. Need design review with eng-network and eng-runtime.

alex: Backup verification (owner: alex) — target: 1 week for verification + 2 weeks for any corrective work. I'll run a retention audit and list any buckets outside policy.

priya: Restore runbook dry-run (owner: priya) — propose 2026-04-06 as a tentative game-day. Can we carve out 2 hours? I want pre-checklist + step-by-step timers.

riley: Pattern analysis (owner: riley) — target: 4 days to produce the initial RCA of recurrence signals and recommended mitigations.

maria: I'll own central tracker + follow-ups in the postmortem doc. Action items below — add any missing context.

maria: ACTIONS:
- jamal: routing policy patch + infra review (due 1997608640)
- alex: backup retention audit + verification script (due 1997604320)
- priya: runbook dry-run plan + runbook updates (draft due 1997605180; game-day 2026-04-06)
- riley: recurring pattern RCA + mitigation suggestions (due 1997602590)
- maria: consolidate updates in postmortem doc & schedule follow-up sync (due 1997601000)

jamal: For the routing change: we need to pin fallback regions and add a weight decay to the traffic router to avoid flapping. I'll open a PR and tag @eng-runtime.

alex: For backups I'll start with this quick check command to validate timestamps and sizes:
```
aws s3 ls s3://redwood-dr-dumps/ --recursive --human-readable | grep 2026-03
```
I'll also run `s3inventory` for a full list.

priya: For the runbook dry-run, here's the pre-check snippet I want to include in the doc:
```
# sanity checks before restore
./scripts/check_network_routes.sh --env staging
./scripts/check_snapshot_integrity.sh --snapshot-id SNAPSHOT-YYYY
```
Keep the restore isolated to the staging VPC, no DNS flips.

riley: I'll share the query I'm using for trend detection in a follow-up thread. It looks for repeated failover signals where latency > 500ms for 3 consecutive minutes combined with increased cross-region egress.

ops-bot: Automated reminder set: follow-up-sync in 5 days (thread 1997600000).

alex: One more ask — can security grant read on KMS audit logs to `alex@redwood` for the audit? @maria can you loop security?

maria: looping @security in the postmortem doc and emailing them. Also adding a field in the tracker for "blocked_by" so we can see dependencies.

jamal: Quick note: if we're changing routing weights we should also add a canary window (10-15 min) and a rollback play in the runbook.

priya: Agreed. I'll add a canary step and explicit rollback commands to the runbook.

riley: If folks want to prep data for the game-day, share replay logs to `s3://redwood-game-day/plays/` and name them with `game-day-<YYYYMMDD>-<component>`.

maria: Solid. I'll update the postmortem doc with these owners/deadlines and a calendar invite for a 30 min follow-up sync next week. If anything slips we re-prioritize the game-day.

alex: ack. I'll start the retention audit today.

jamal: ack. Opening PR for routing policy tomorrow morning.

priya: I'll draft the dry-run checklist by EOD Thursday.

riley: Will post the RCA query results in 48 hours.

maria: Thanks everyone — small, focused tasks. I'll post the tracker link in this thread once it's up. :eyes: :white_check_mark:
